formal_role: Specifies the surface over which the integral is computed
systems_modeling_role: Determines the boundary membrane terrain envelope or control surface being analyzed
review_warning: A surface integral is not interpretable without a clearly defined surface

formal_role: Defines the normal direction for flux calculations
systems_modeling_role: Determines what counts as positive crossing outflow or inflow
review_warning: Reversing the normal reverses flux sign

formal_role: Converts parameter or projected area into actual surface area
systems_modeling_role: Accounts for curvature slope and geometry
review_warning: Projected area can underestimate curved or sloped surfaces

formal_role: Accumulates scalar field values over surface area
systems_modeling_role: Supports pressure load exposure radiation contamination or burden interpretation
review_warning: Units combine scalar field units and area units

formal_role: Measures vector-field crossing through an oriented surface
systems_modeling_role: Supports flow energy water material air or emissions accounting
review_warning: Vector-field units normal direction and area units must be compatible

formal_role: Defines how the continuous surface is approximated by patches
systems_modeling_role: Shapes computed area scalar accumulation and flux
review_warning: Coarse meshes can miss curvature or field variation

formal_role: Checks whether normals point in a coherent direction
systems_modeling_role: Supports inflow outflow and conservation accounting
review_warning: Inconsistent normals can cancel or invert flux
